description: React component for a pet form, handling creation and update of pet data with API interactions.

methods.name: putData
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update existing pet data in the database.

methods.name: postData
methods.description: Sends a POST request to add new pet data to the database.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles form input changes and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates data, and triggers create or update actions.

methods.name: formValidate
methods.description: Validates form fields to ensure required data is present.
